recommended_next_target.name: TestBreakInComplexIf
recommended_next_target.reason: It has a public finite check that exercises both ordinary loop completion and a condition-triggered break, without filesystem effects, a sleeping exception path, smali-only input, or uninitialized iterator state. It therefore provides a small full-original Java comparison with a direct semantic oracle.

limitations: Source assertions and check methods are inspected, not executed in this audit.
The 13-file CF-09 inventory includes TestBreakInLoop6.java, but that test is SmaliTest and consumes a separate smali fixture; it is not a Java source compilation target.
The older cf09-loop-transfers replay uses Grid and OuterContinue, not these fixed full original classes.
No evidence was found in the checked baseline/evidence locations for the remaining nine targets beyond the explicit unexecuted DoWhileBreak preparation.
